paragraphs: The A319 is the short one in its family, and low cost carriers took to it because a shorter aircraft on the same wing turns a marginal route into a profitable one. EasyJet built a network out of exactly that arithmetic, and the orange tail became one of the most recognisable liveries in European aviation.

The airframe holds 254,266 polygons and 260,304 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 33 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $149 it suits flight simulation, airline and airport visualisation, advertising and travel imagery, film backgrounds and editorial illustration. On sale since 2018.
